metadata.description: Brendan Kowitz's marketplace of agents, skills, and commands for GitHub Copilot CLI.

plugins.name: pr-review-toolkit
plugins.description: Six specialized PR review agents (code quality, test coverage, silent failures, comment accuracy, type design, simplification) plus a /pr-review-toolkit command that orchestrates them all. Ported from Anthropic's Claude Code pr-review-toolkit (Apache-2.0).

plugins.name: copilot-code-template
plugins.description: AI-native development workflow for Copilot CLI: 7 agents and 14 skills for a feature-first lifecycle (investigate, ADR, implement, verify, document) plus Well-Architected reviews.

plugins.name: claude-code-template
plugins.description: The same AI-native workflow in its original Claude Code form: 7 agents and 14 slash commands, packaged for Copilot CLI.
